test_title: PYST 7: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Reasoning (Held On: 14th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: P said to Q: "The relative I met today was the wife of the grandfather of your mother's only son." How is the relative related to Q?
solution:
• Your mother’s only son
 
 
• If Q’s mother has only one son, that son must be Q (since Q is addressed directly).
 
 
 
• Grandfather of Q
 
 
• This is Q’s grandfather.
 
 
 
• Wife of Q’s grandfather
 
 
• The wife of one’s grandfather is one’s grandmother.
 
 

Therefore, the relative that P met is:

Q’s grandmother.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**
